results.statement: For every physical cross block B and every deterministic right orthogonal projection P in a slab witness of ratio rho, either s3(B)<=9sqrt(3e)/rho or the natural squared-third-minor law has a physical row and column of marginal >2/3 and joint mass >1/3. In the former branch B(I-P)=L+F with rank(L)<=2 and ||F||op<=(9sqrt(3e)+10sqrt(2e))/rho.

Under the partner diffuse retained-range hypotheses and rho>48, absent the physical third-volume bi-hub, at least one holds: R_U R_V>rho ell/(8C*); tau R_V^2>ell/8; or a rank<=2 L obeys ||L|| R_U R_V>ell/16, C*=9sqrt(3e)+10sqrt(2e).
